company_name: Shenzhen Tensun Precision Equipment Co., Ltd
semiconductor_relevance: High — Shenzhen Tensun Precision Equipment Co., Ltd specializes in precision dispensing and cutting technologies that are critical for semiconductor packaging and testing.
summary: Shenzhen Tensun Precision Equipment Co., Ltd focuses on precision dispensing and cutting (dicing) equipment, primarily serving the 3C mobile phone industry and semiconductor packaging sectors. The company has developed core technologies that position it as a preferred brand for dispensing and cutting solutions in advanced applications like OLED and MEMS.
capabilities: Precision dispensing equipment for semiconductor packaging
Precision cutting (dicing) technology for wafer processing
Automatic system integration for manufacturing processes

regional_presence.China: The company is based in Shenzhen, China, and is deeply involved in the local semiconductor and electronics manufacturing ecosystem.
